name: godoc-peek
description: Peek Go documentation for pkg.Symbol written in Markdown, comments and string literals

godocPeek.markdown.enabled.description: Hover over `pkg.Symbol` inside inline code spans in Markdown files.

godocPeek.goComments.enabled.description: Hover over pkg.Symbol inside Go comments and string literals, where gopls shows nothing.

godocPeek.networkFallback.description: When `go doc` cannot resolve a package locally, `go get` it into a scratch module and retry (requires network).

godocPeek.maxLines.description: Maximum number of documentation lines shown in the hover before truncation.

godocPeek.goDoc.workingDirectory.description: Directory used to run `go doc`. Leave empty to search upwards from the current file for the nearest go.mod.

scripts.validate: npm run compile && npm run lint
